domain_migration.name: 02. Unjoin Old Domain
domain_migration.template:
# ===============================
# PRE-UNJOIN DOMAIN SCRIPT
# Local admin + stop services + unjoin
# ===============================

Write-Host "=== Pre-Unjoin preparation started ==="

# -------- VARIABLES (EDIT IF NEEDED) --------
$OldDomainUser  = "'{{OldDomainUser}}'"     # Ninja Secure Variable
$OldDomainPass  = "'{{OldDomainPass}}'" # Ninja Secure Variable

# -------- STOP PROBLEMATIC PROCESSES --------
Write-Host "Stopping user-dependent processes..."

$Processes = @(
    "OneDrive.exe",
    "ms-teams.exe",
    "Teams.exe",
    "msedge.exe",
    "chrome.exe"
)

foreach ($p in $Processes) {
    taskkill /f /im $p 2>$null
}

Write-Host "Processes stopped."

# -------- BUILD OLD DOMAIN CREDENTIAL --------
Write-Host "Preparing domain credentials..."

$SecurePass = ConvertTo-SecureString $OldDomainPass -AsPlainText -Force
$OldDomainCred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential (
    $OldDomainUser,
    $SecurePass
)

# -------- UNJOIN DOMAIN --------
Write-Host "Unjoining from old domain..."

Remove-Computer `
  -UnjoinDomainCredential $OldDomainCred `
  -Force `
  -Restart

# Script ends here – machine will reboot

domain_migration.name: 03. Join New Domain
domain_migration.template:
# ===============================
# NinjaOne – Join Domain (Stable)
# ===============================

Write-Host "=== Domain Join Process Started ==="

# -------- ENV VARIABLES --------
$DomainJoinUser     = $env:DOMAINJOINUSER
$DomainJoinPassword = $env:DOMAINJOINPASSWORD
$NewDomainFQDN      = $env:NEWDOMAINFQDN

# ---- Hard validation ----
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DomainJoinUser)) {
    Write-Error "DomainJoinUser is missing"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($DomainJoinPassword)) {
    Write-Error "DomainJoinPassword is missing"
    exit 1
}
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($NewDomainFQDN)) {
    Write-Error "NewDomainFQDN is missing"
    exit 1
}

# -------- SET DNS TO NEW DC --------
$NewDomainDC = "'{{dns_server_ip}}'"   # <-- change if needed

Write-Host "Setting DNS to $NewDomainDC"

$adapter = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq "Up"} | Select-Object -First 1

if (-not $adapter) {
    Write-Error "No active network adapter found"
    exit 1
}

Set-DnsClientServerAddress `
    -InterfaceIndex $adapter.ifIndex `
    -ServerAddresses $NewDomainDC

ipconfig /flushdns | Out-Null

# -------- QUICK DNS CHECK --------
try {
    Resolve-DnsName $NewDomainFQDN -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null
}
catch {
    Write-Error "DNS resolution failed"
    exit 1
}

Write-Host "Joining domain $NewDomainFQDN using $DomainJoinUser"

# ---- Build credential ----
$SecurePass = ConvertTo-SecureString $DomainJoinPassword -AsPlainText -Force
$Cred = New-Object System.Management.Automation.PSCredential (
    $DomainJoinUser,
    $SecurePass
)

# ---- Join ----
Add-Computer `
  -DomainName $NewDomainFQDN `
  -Credential $Cred `
  -Force `
  -Restart
